fact: Car 4 left the track on the straight between T5 and T6 and allegedly gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 4 overtook Car 22 off track however this occurred because the driver of Car 22 made multiple moves defending his position against Car 4. Had Car 22 not made those moves, Car 4 would have overtaken it without going off track but moved off track to avoid contact with Car 22. Further, the Driving Standards Guidelines provide that if a car is "forced off" (which was effectively what occurred here) it is not considered to have exceeded track limits. Whilst technically the overtake took place off track, we determine in view of the above, to take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 4 Alleged Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
